verdict_text: NO: the merge formula is wrong. Instead of computing out = base + λ(ft1-base) + λ(ft2-base) against the unmodified base as required by clause 2, the script computes tmp = base + λ(ft1-base), then out = tmp + λ(ft2-tmp) — the second task vector is taken against the already-modified `tmp`, not against the unmodified base. This violates the explicit ordering requirement ("each task vector must be taken against the unmodified base, not against a base that the first merge already changed") and yields a mathematically different result (out = base + λ(ft1-base) + λ(1-λ)(ft2-base), not base + λ(ft1-base) + λ(ft2-base)), which will fail the grading tolerance.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
